label: nhanes-iii-linked-mortality-2019
note: NHANES III (1988-1994) public-use linked mortality file: fixed-width ASCII with MORTSTAT/ELIGSTAT/UCOD and follow-up months (PERMTH_EXM), mortality status through 2019-12-31 for the adult cohort; 1.66 MB; curl HEAD 200, range GET 206, full GET 200 (1663910 bytes).

label: nhis-2018-linked-mortality-2019
note: NHIS 2018 public-use linked mortality file: fixed-width ASCII with survey-mortality linkage (MORTSTAT, follow-up months) for the 2018 NHIS sample; 1.33 MB; curl HEAD 200, range GET 206, full GET 200 (1330334 bytes).

label: nchs-us-life-tables-2021
note: Table 1 (life table for the total US population, 2021) from United States Life Tables, 2021: period life table with age-specific qx, lx, dx, Lx, Tx, ex by single year of age; 20.8 KB xlsx; curl HEAD 200, range GET 206, full GET 200 (20764 bytes). Sibling tables Table02-Table20 cover sex/race/ethnicity.

label: rhesus-macaque-early-life-adversity-survival
note: Individual-level survival/follow-up records for a free-ranging rhesus macaque population analysed for early-life-adversity effects on lifespan (Cayo Santiago, with age, sex, adversity exposures and event/censoring information); 895 KB CSV beginning 'group,An...', payload byte count 895168 matches the record; curl HEAD 200, range GET 206. Zenodo DOIs are DataCite-registered, so the identifier given here is the Crossref-registered journal article (Phil. Trans. R. Soc. B) for the same data.

label: nhefs-1992-causal-inference-cohort
license: Public domain (NCHS public-use data); redistributed in the causaldata textbook data package
note: NHEFS 1992 follow-up cohort as the standard confounding/selection analysis extract: 1629 rows, smoking-cessation exposure qsmk, weight-change outcome wt82_71, plus age, sex, race, education, income, blood pressure and the censoring flag; 67 KB R data file (bzip2 payload, magic BZh9); curl HEAD 200, range GET 206. The original fixed-width NCHS files (N92mort.txt, N92int.txt) sit on ftp.cdc.gov under /pub/Health_Statistics/NCHS/Datasets/NHEFS/. Two other copies were tested and rejected: the Harvard CDN nhefs.csv is now a soft-404 serving an HTML page, and the Stata .dta extract trips content-type sniffers because Stata's binary header begins '<stata_dta><header>'.

label: mr-method-benchmark-datasets
note: Curated GWAS summary-statistic pairs for benchmarking two-way/two-sample Mendelian randomisation and other summary-data causal estimators: LDL-cholesterol to coronary artery disease, plus negative-control and pleiotropy datasets (Neale Lab, Pan-UKBB, GWASATLAS, family-level confounding); this file 126 KB zip (payload starts PK), sibling archives 0.8-27 MB; curl HEAD 200, range GET 206.

label: nhanes-2017-2018-linked-mortality-2019
note: Continuous NHANES (2017-2018 cycle) public-use linked mortality file: SEQN keyed to the NHANES interview/examination/laboratory files, with MORTSTAT and person-months of follow-up, so exposure-outcome effects can be estimated with full confounder adjustment; 450 KB fixed-width ASCII; curl HEAD 200, range GET 206, full GET 200 (449623 bytes). Note the DOI literally contains a double colon (10.15620/cdc::117142) as registered by NCHS.

label: harmonised-aging-cohorts-frailty-cvd
note: Cleaned, harmonised individual-level cohort data plus analysis code for a study of frailty and depressive symptoms against cardiovascular-disease risk in middle-aged and older adults, pooled from HRS, CHARLS, SHARE, ELSA and MHAS: the shape a cross-cohort confounding/adjustment or mediation task needs; 46 MB zip (payload starts PK), sibling code in Stata and R; curl HEAD 200, range GET 206. Identifier is the Crossref-registered Nature Communications paper the deposit declares as isSupplementTo.

label: gtex-v8-sample-attributes
license: GTEx open access: summary-level files are downloadable without registration; raw sequence data require dbGaP authorisation
note: GTEx v8 sample annotation table: 17,382 tissue samples with SMTSD tissue, donor SUBJID, batch, library prep (SMNABTCH, SMCENTER) for cross-tissue integration against the gene-TPM matrices on the same bucket; 11.5 MB TSV; curl HEAD 200, range GET 206. Companion donor file GTEx_Analysis_v8_Annotations_SubjectPhenotypesDS.txt (20 KB) carries age bracket, sex and death classification.

label: cellxgene-tabula-muris-senis-large-intestine
license: CELLxGENE Discover public collection; no explicit licence statement on the collection record (raw data at GEO GSE132042)
note: One tissue slice of the Tabula Muris Senis ageing mouse atlas as an AnnData h5ad (Large intestine, Smart-seq2): 1887 cells with age, sex, cell-type and ontology labels ready for integration with the other 41 datasets in the same CELLxGENE collection; 44.2 MB; curl HEAD 200, range GET 206.

label: gse132042-tabula-muris-senis-mouse-atlas
note: GEO series GSE132042, the Tabula Muris Senis super-series: 996 samples of mouse single-cell RNA-seq across ages (1, 3, 18, 21, 24, 30 months) and tissues, with processed CSV/H5AD/LOOM/MTX supplementary archives; the directory listing serves the supplementary files directly; curl HEAD 200, range GET 200.

label: gse202601-human-ovarian-aging-multiomics
note: Single-nucleus multi-omics series of human ovarian ageing: paired snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq (16 samples), giving matched transcriptome and chromatin-accessibility modalities for integration and peak-gene linkage; directory listing with H5/RDS/TSV supplementary files; curl HEAD 200, range GET 200.

label: methylclock-data-clock-coefficients
license: No licence declared on the Zenodo deposit (record is open access); the upstream methylclockData Bioconductor package is Artistic-2.0
note: Coefficient tables for 29 published epigenetic clocks (this file: DunedinPACE CpG weights; siblings include EpiTOC1/2, AltumAge, AdaptAge, DamAge, CausAge, Garma, RepliTali and the McCartney trait clocks) as .rda objects, i.e. the reference values a biomarker-validation task scores against; 3.6 KB, payload begins with the xz magic 0xfd377a585a; curl HEAD 200, range GET 206. Identifier is the Crossref-registered methylclock package paper, because Zenodo DOIs are DataCite-only and are not resolvable through Crossref.

label: retroelement-age-clock-coefficients
license: No licence declared on the Zenodo deposit (record is open access; deposited by TruDiagnostic)
note: Retroelement-Age (Retro-Age) clock coefficients: per-CpG intercept and weights as a plain CSV with header ',name,coefficient', published alongside a methylation dataset and build script, giving an independent clock to validate against Horvath/Hannum/PhenoAge; 43.7 KB CSV, byte count 43716 matches the record; curl HEAD 200, range GET 206. Identifier is the bioRxiv preprint DOI for the same clock.

label: gse90124-skin-dna-methylome-aging
note: DNA methylome of skin punch biopsies from 322 healthy female donors spanning the adult age range: the reference cohort against which a skin/blood epigenetic clock or other methylation biomarker can be calibrated and tested for age prediction error; Illumina array beta values as series-level supplementary TXT; curl HEAD 200, range GET 200.

label: bioage-nhanes4-biomarker-data
license: GPL-3.0 (BioAge R package); bundled NHANES source data are public domain (NCHS)
note: NHANES IV (1999-2010) participant table shipped with the BioAge toolkit: the clinical blood-chemistry, organ-function and demographic variables needed to recompute PhenoAge, homeostatic dysregulation and Klemera-Doubal biological age and to validate them against outcomes; 3.77 MB .rda (R data); curl HEAD 200, range GET 206, full GET 200 (3768941 bytes).
